description: Add one item to the shopping list for the week that holds weekStart. The week needs a plan.

displayName.description: What to buy, e.g. 'melk' or 'kaffe'. Include the amount in quantity/unit rather than in the name.

quantity.description: Amount, if the user said one, e.g. 2.

unit.description: Unit for the quantity, e.g. 'l', 'stk', 'g'; omit if none.

weekStart.description: Any date in the week whose list gets the item.

name: add_shopping_item
title: Add to shopping list
